claim: Maredsous Abbey's Saint-Joseph reception centre is open every day of the year except 1 January, weekdays 11:00-18:00 and weekends/public holidays 10:00-19:00.
quote: OPEN EACH DAY OF THE YEAR EXCEPT ON JANUARY THE 1ST ... Opened from 11 o'clock until 18 o'clock ... Opened from 10 o'clock until 19 o'clock

claim: The Saint-Joseph reception offers a 1h30 guided tasting visit of the micro-brewery and hop field with special on-site-only beers, plus a cafeteria serving Maredsous beer, cheese and bread.
quote: a tasting visit (1h30) offers a guided discovery of the micro-brewery and hop field, with special beers available for tasting only on site

claim: Jardins d'Annevoie open April-October daily 09:30-17:30; adult admission €9.50, children €5.50; group rate €11 adults.
quote: From April to October: open daily from 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM ... adult admission is €9.50 and children are €5.50

claim: Annevoie's gardens were begun around 1758 by Charles-Alexis de Montpellier and blend French formality, Italian water-as-soul layout and English Romantic naturalism — designated Major Walloon Heritage between 1992-2009.
quote: French approach: Formal perspectives without curves ... Italian approach: Natural variety integrated into the landscape, with water as 'the soul of the gardens' ... English approach: Artificially created natural effects

claim: Annevoie's 50 water features have run continuously since 1758 without pumps, using only gravity — engineering reputed superior to Versailles, and the only historical water gardens in Belgium.
quote: The 50 water features in this garden all work without any pumps and machinery and rely on the laws of gravity

claim: Floreffe Abbey's Moulin-Brasserie is open year-round daily 11:00-18:00 (weekends until 20:00); abbey-church guided tours run 1 April-30 September at 13:30, 14:30, 16:00 and 17:00 (€8 including guide), and a self-guided exterior booklet costs €5.
quote: Le moulin-brasserie est ouvert tous les jours de 11h à 18h ... Les visites de l'abbatiale se font à 13h30, 14h30, 16h et 17h ... Le prix de la visite, guidage inclus, est 8,00 €

claim: TreM.a (Musée des Arts anciens du Namurois, rue de Fer 24 in central Namur) opens Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-13:00 and 13:30-18:00; €5 adult permanent (€8 with temporary exhibition), free the first Sunday of each month.
quote: Du mardi au dimanche 10h00 – 13h00 / 13h30 – 18h00 ... Adults: €5 (permanent collections only) or €8 (with temporary exhibitions) ... First Sunday of each month: Free for all

claim: TreM.a houses the Trésor d'Oignies — gold-and-silver liturgical work by Hugo d'Oignies and his workshop (c. 1225-1250) — alongside sculptures by the Master of Waha and paintings by Henri Bles.
quote: medieval treasures of the priory of Saint-Nicolas d'Oignies ... created by the goldsmith Hugo d'Oignies or his workshop between approximately 1225-1250

claim: Musée Félicien Rops in Namur opens Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-18:00 (daily in July-August); combined ticket €5 (€2.50 reduced); closed 24-25 Dec, 31 Dec, 1 Jan and the 3rd weekend of September.
quote: from 10 to 18h Tuesday to Sunday ... In July and August, it is open every day from 10h to 18h ... Combined museum and temporary exhibition admission is €5

claim: Dinant's Maison de la Pataphonie offers public sessions on Sundays, holidays and school holidays at 14:00 and 16:00, plus reserved slots on Wednesdays and the first Sunday of each month, in an instrumentarium by luthier Max Vandervorst built from everyday objects.
quote: Sundays, public holidays and school holidays at 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM ... unique instrumentarium, imagined by wild luthier Max Vandervorst

claim: Maredret Abbey's church is open daily for individual visits; French-language guided tours (1h-1h30) run the first Sunday of each month April-October, and the monastic shop sells abbey beer, jams, honey, ceramics and the famous Maredret illuminations.
quote: L'église est ouverte tous les jours pour une visite individuelle ... Les visites guidées se font tous les premiers dimanches du mois à partir d'avril jusqu'à octobre

claim: Profondeville to Maredsous is roughly 10 km as the crow flies and about 17 km by road, putting Maredsous/Maredret well within the 30 km radius of Arbre.
quote: Approximately 10.4 km in a straight line (as the crow flies) ... 17.21 km by car
